project_only_lessons: A Script UID sidecar added after a scene reference needs an editor-authored rebind and scene save; loader text-path fallback is evidence of drift, not a repair.
Passing GUT behavior tests and process-exit orphan/RID reports are separate facts; repairs must not claim either one resolves the other.
Automatic image authorization applies when a real consumer gap exists; it does not justify creating a raster asset for source-warning maintenance.
